requirements.text: use case diagrams have use cases
Use case diagrams have use case containers
Use case diagrams have behavioured classifiers
Use case diagrams have name elements, which have a name
Use cases are composed by includes
Use case diagrams have extends. Each extend extends one or more use cases
Use case diagrams have includes. each include includes one or more use cases
Use case diagrams have use case containers. Each container is owned by zero or more named element
Use case diagrams have associations, each one could be linked to an actor
